item.text:
HTTPX keeps connection pools on its transports and delegates connection reuse, idle eviction, and waiting for an available connection to `httpcore`.

- **Clients.** `Client` and `AsyncClient` create a default transport and select a transport for each request based on the URL and configured mounts. Requests routed through the same transport share its pool, so eligible connections can be reused across requests. [httpx/_client.py](<work>/httpx-base/httpx/_client.py:718)
- **Transports.** `HTTPTransport` and `AsyncHTTPTransport` wrap `httpcore.ConnectionPool` and `httpcore.AsyncConnectionPool`, respectively. For proxy routes they use the corresponding HTTP or SOCKS proxy pool. The transports forward requests to their pool and close it when the client closes. [httpx/_transports/default.py](<work>/httpx-base/httpx/_transports/default.py:135)
- **Configuration.** `Limits` defaults to 100 total connections, 20 idle keep-alive connections, and a 5-second idle expiry. `Timeout.pool` controls how long a request can wait to acquire a connection. The transport translates `httpcore.PoolTimeout` into `httpx.PoolTimeout`. [httpx/_config.py](<work>/httpx-base/httpx/_config.py:159) · [httpx/_transports/default.py](<work>/httpx-base/httpx/_transports/default.py:74)
